_comment: Your lecture library. Edit this file, commit, and it appears on the iPad. Every entry needs a type and a title; the rest depends on the type. Paths are relative to the podium/ directory, so podium/content/slides/week1/index.html is referenced as content/slides/week1/index.html. The 'Working examples' group below actually plays, out of the box, with files that ship in this repo - open one to see what a real entry looks like. The 'Template - point these at your files' group are illustrations of the format for content that has to be yours (a PDF, a photo, a video); their src paths do not exist yet and picking one will show an error until you replace it or delete the entry.
